Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! India have won their first T20I against England in England due to which they have also taken a 1-0 lead in the series. England, on the other hand, will somehow have to come up with a solution on how to play Kuldeep Yadav. There are still a few days for the next game which will be played on the 6th of July at 1730 local (1630 GMT). Will the visitors once again blow the hosts away or will the home side fight back? Join us to find out. Till then, goodbye and take care.

Man of the Match, Kuldeep Yadav says it is the perfect start to his first tour in England. Reckons the wicket suited him and he stuck to bowling line and length. Adds further he looked to land the googly in the perfect area and it went well for him. Mentions Kohli and Dhoni guided him well and he is happy to play under them. Ends by saying he will hope to continue his form.

India skipper, Virat Kohli says they were very convincing in this game. He is happy about the youngsters stepping up. Praises Rahul and Kuldeep for the way they played. He reckons Kuldeep's over changed it for them. He feels England scored at least 30 or 40 less than what they should have.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan starts by saying India played really well. Adds further the conditions were good and India fought back really hard. Acknowledges the knock of Rahul. Admits they failed to take all the chances that came to them and they can't afford to do that when they are defending an average total. Ends by saying India outplayed them in this game.

The England bowlers had no answers to the onslaught. The pacers were taken to the cleaners and the spinners, from whom a lot was expected, also could not deliver. Rashid and Willey did bowl well but when you are defending a total which is below par you need everybody to chip in which was not the case for England in this game.

Chasing 160, India lost Dhawan early. Rahul then joined forces with Sharma and the two plundered the bowling. More Rahul than Rohit who was happy to play second fiddle. The duo added 123 in just 71 balls which turned the tide completely in India's favour. Rohit fell 8 shot of his half ton but Rahul continued. He along with Kohli ensured there were no further hiccups. The latter got to his ton while the skipper hit the winning runs in style.

A mockery is what India have made of this run chase and it is courtesy a brilliant ton by Rahul. He walks off to a standing ovation from the crowd. He along with Kuldeep, who took a fifer, has made this English side look really ordinary.

SIX! India have done it, they have won by 8 wickets. A complete performance from them. Kohli had enough of it as the bottom hand comes into play. The ball easily goes up and over the long on boundary for a maximum.
A flighted ball around middle, KL gets it through mid-wicket. Three more runs required now.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack.

And he has done it! Take a bow, Lokesh Rahul. He has made a few more fans today, without a doubt. A gentle half tracker on leg, Rahul tucks it fine and takes the awaited single. He is pumped and rightly so! Second ton for the classy right-hander in T20Is, perhaps more important for his career. And he dabs to finish off the celebrations.
A full ball outside off, Kohli guides it behind point for a single and gets to the other end, finally.
Kohli drives the fullish ball through the mid-wicket region and takes two comfortably. Rahul has to wait for his century.
A shortish ball on the hips, Rahul gets it to the on side and takes a single. 99 now!

FOUR! As easy as you like. A length ball on middle and leg, Rahul gets into position and plays the flick. He gets it to the left of Moeen at fine leg as the ball races away to the boundary. Just two more needed for a well deserving century for KL Rahul.
A back of length ball in line of the stumps, Kohli hangs back and punches it to long on for a single.
Kohli plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes down the track to meet the fullish ball. He hits it straight to the man at point.
Wide! Virat tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
A back of length in line of the stumps, Kohli blocks it out down the track.
A slower ball outside off, Rahul plays it to mid off and sets off for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the stumps but KL would have made it in time had that hit.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for a run.
A length ball outside off, driven to mid off for nothing.
Short of a length in line of the stumps, Kohli gives charge and dabs it behind point for another single. This also brings up 2000 T20I runs for the Indian skipper.
On a length on the pads, Rahul flicks it fine to Moeen at fine leg. One run taken.
A bumper. the umpire signals one for the over as KL misses the pull.
A short ball outside off, Kohli guides it to third man. 20 runs needed off 27 balls.
On a length around middle and off, punched to covers for a single.
A touch too straight, Virat gets it to fine leg and changes strike.
David Willey is back into the attack.
Strokes this through covers and runs a single which means Rahul will not be on strike.
Left alone! Something you don't see a lot, especially in the 15th over. India though can afford to do this as the required rate is very low. Flatter outside off, left alone.
Floats it up on off, Kohli drives it to covers.
Uses his feet and eases it to long off for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
The googly on middle, Virat works it to mid-wicket.
A touch too straight, Kohli guides it to fine leg and changes strike.
Played through mid-wicket by Kohli.
Hangs back and punches the shortish delivery to the on side for a single.

NOT OUT! The third umpire agrees with the on-field umpire. It was a short ball into the body of KL who goes for the pull but misses. The keeper collects it and an appeal ensues. The umpire nods in disagreement but Morgan goes for a review, a desperate one. The replays shows the ball to have hit Rahul's forearm.
A review has been taken for a caught behind. The umpire rules it not out but Buttler is convinced there is an edge. Rahul however, later on indicates it has hit his forearm.
A back of a length around off, guided to third man. One run taken.
Full on the pads, Kohli dabs it to mid-wicket for nothing.
Hangs back in his crease and keeps it out. End of a successful over for England.
Virat Kohli comes to the crease and drives the fullish ball down the ground for a single.

OUT! Gone. A wicket against the run of play. Rohit looks to get into the act as well. Adil tosses this one up outside off, Sharma sees this as an opportunity and plays the lofted cover drive straight to Morgan stationed there. A wicket too late in the context of the game as they don't really celebrate it. Rohit Sharma played the perfect foil for KL Rahul. A magnificent partnership comes to an end which has completely tilted the game into India's favour. They need another 33.
Rahul rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A flighted ball outside off, Rohit waits for it and gets it through covers for a single.
A flighted ball around middle and off, driven back to the bowler.
Adil Rashid is back.

Rohit now caresses it through covers and gets to the other end. India need another 32, Rohit needs another 19 for his half ton and Rahul needs 12 for his ton. So all three look possible at the moment.
Shorter in length outside off, Rahul guides it down to third man for a single.

Excellent work once again from Willey! A full toss on the pads, Rahul flicks it through backward square leg. Willey from fine leg runs to his left, dives and pushes it back in. A couple taken. He now moves onto a number which the Australians believe to be unlucky.
Fuller in length on middle, Rahul tries to drive it through the off side but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler. Jordan collects the ball and mimes a shy at the keeper's end.
OUCH! A slower short ball on middle, Rahul swivels and pulls but misses. He gets hit on his chest. He seems to be in some pain.
A full toss on the pads, Rohit flicks it through square leg and says Rahul let me watch you from the other end.
Chris Jordan is back for another spell.

SIX! That is nonchalantly hit by Rahul. A short ball targeting the grille. He swivels once again and packs a punch with the shot. He has timed that superbly as the ball lands straight into the crowd in the square leg stands. 20 off the over. He is getting away with the game now.
Rahul gets a bottom edge! The keeper gathers it on the bounce.

FOUR! And another. He has taken a liking to Plunkett it seems. He is liking the pace. A nothing delivery on the hips, Rahul swivels and tucks it behind square leg. The fielder from fine leg looks to cut it out but fails as the ball goes over the line.

FOUR! Creamed over covers now. He has all the shots in book. What a gem of an innings he is playing. Plunkett looks to bowl a yorker but ends up dishing out a gentle half volley on a driveable length. KL drive through the line and gets it over the infield. He holds the pose for the cameras as the ball rolls to the fence.

SIX! That is dismissive! I have no other words to describe the beauty of the shot. Plunkett bowls a shortish delivery around the hips, Rahul just uses the pace of the ball and guides it over the deep square leg fence. The ball has enough wings to it to go into the elated spectators.
Defended off the front foot by Rahul presenting the full face of the bat.
Liam Plunkett is back into the attack.
A length ball around off, driven through mid on for a single. 14 off the over and he keeps the strike for the next over as well.

SIX! I am out of words now. He is making me speechless. A flighted delivery around off, KL comes down the track and lifts it handsomely over the long on fence. The fielder there can only watch it go over the boundary and into the crowd. He is running the show now.
FOUR! Innovation comes into the fore now. A quicker one on off, Rahul gets into position quickly to play the switch hit. He has thread the needle like a professional. What a star he is.
Driven through mid-on by Sharma. One run added to the total.
Flatter on the pads, KL guides it through mid-wicket. Another run taken.
A touch short on middle and off, Rohit punches it off the back foot for a single.

FOUR! Delicate and deft, words one relate with KL Rahul. A quicker ball outside off, KL uses the speed and guides it past the third man fielder for a boundary. With the shot, he brings up his half century as well, second one on the trot. 13 runs off the over as well.
Flat and full, Rohit sweeps it to square leg region for another single.
A touch short outside off, Rahul cuts it to point. One run taken.
Tossed up around middle and off, Rohit drives it down the ground and changes strike.
Flighted around off, driven back to the bowler.
SIX! A rocket! A half tracker and asking for it. Rohit obliges and hits it powerfully over the mid-wicket fence. The bal sails way back in to the crowd.
16 from Ali's first! A couple to finish! Rahul whips this through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and an easy two for the batters.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Tucks it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run.
This is good batting, got 10 from the first two balls, now he plays this with soft hands through mid-wicket and runs two.

DROPPED AND SIX! A tough chance for Jordan. Rahul uses his feet and gets to the pitch of it. Tries to clear long on but does not get it off the middle. Jordan there who is very close to the ropes tries to catch it but palms it over the fence. Rahul's luck continues and it has not been a good beginning for Ali. 10 from his first two balls.

FOUR! Brilliant by Rahul! The first ball he faces of Moeen Ali, he brings out the reverse sweep, connects it well and hits it fine through the off side for a boundary. So consecutive boundaries for India.
Moeen Ali is into the attack.

FOUR! Spoils the over completely! This is exactly what England did not need, they needed a tight over here. Rashid bowls a short ball outside off, it was also quicker. Sharma rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Flights it on middle, Rohit drives it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball on middle, Rohit could not resist as he went for the slog sweep. He gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
The googly on off, Sharma guides it to short third man.
Quicker outside off, Rahul hits it through covers and gets to the other end.
Flatter on middle, Sharma punches it down to long on for a run.
Adil Rashid is into the attack.
Another single through mid-wicket as the batsmen take six off the last over of the Powerplay. India needs 106 off the 14 overs now.
A length ball on the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single. The fifty-run stand between the two is up.
FOUR! Easy peasy for KL. Another short ball targeting the grille, Rahul hangs back in his crease, swivels and gets it over the fielder at short third man. The ball runs down to the fine leg boundary.
Good ball. A slower bouncer and evades the flashing blade of KL.
A full toss on off, punched to covers.
Full in line of the stumps, driven to mid on for nothing.
FOUR! In the air.. but in the gap! Full and it is the slower ball on off, Sharma lofts it but in the gap through extra cover for a boundary. Another expensive over, 10 from it.

Almost drags it on! A lovely slower ball by Jordan on the shorter side. Rohit Sharma dances down the track but is foxed by the slowness on the delivery. He is way too early into the pull as the ball takes the bottom edge and goes agonizingly close past the off pole. He drops his bat and holds his elbow. Buttler collects the ball and scores a direct hit at his end but Rohit makes it back in.
Change of pace by Jordan on middle, Rahul tucks it through mid-wicket and gives the strike over to Rohit.
Bowls a bouncer! A good one. It hurries onto the batsman as he goes for the pull. The ball hits the splice of the bat goes towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Rohit Sharma gets into the act now! This is very full outside off, Sharma squeezes it onto the ground. The hardness of the wicket is such that the ball bounces over the point fielder and into the fence.
On a length around off, kept out.
Chris Jordan is back on.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries and India are off to a brilliant start even though they have lost a wicket. 122 more needed. This is another short ball outside off, Rahul slaps it through point and a boundary results. He moves onto 26.
FOUR! Bread and butter for Rahul! Down the leg side, he helps it on its way, fine down the leg side for another boundary.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off, Rahul goes for the cut but is beaten by the extra bounce. The umpire feels it is too wide outside off and stretches his hands.
Sharma makes room and Plunkett bowls a slower one on middle, Sharma pulls it with one hand off the blade to deep square leg for another run.
Slower ball on middle, Rahul flicks it through mid-wicket for another single.
Drags his length back and bowls it on off, Sharma guides it down to third man for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Sharma drives it to mid off.
Liam Plunkett is into the attack.

DROPPED! That went to Roy like a rocket but the standards he sets for himself in the field, it should have been taken. This is very full outside off, Rahul slices it uppishly towards Roy at point. He gets two hands to it but fails to hang on. A reprieve for Rahul. England can't afford this, especially with the total they have on the board.
FOUR! Delightful! This guy is in sublime touch! Not a lot wrong with the delivery. Maybe it is a touch too full outside off, Rahul strokes it on the up through covers and there is no stopping those.
A full toss on off, Rahul strokes it to mid off.
On middle, Rahul tucks it through mid-wicket and runs two. Good running.
Sharma walks down the track but misses the flick. The ball hits his pads and goes towards point. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
Good length on off, Rahul pushes it through covers for a run.
OOOO! Bends his back on this one and bowls it short outside off, Sharma tries to get on top of the bounce and cut it but misses. No edge luckily for the opener.
Better from Jordan. Length ball on off, Sharma keeps it out.

Very well fielded by David Willey! A brilliant effort by him, especially after bowling the last over. Jordan over compensates by bowling it very straight. Not somewhere you want to bowl to an Indian batsman. Rahul flicks it through mid-wicket. Willey hares after it and saves a run for his side with a dive before the ball could cross the ropes.
Another cracking drive but finds the fielder at cover-point.

SIX! WOW! Shot of the match! One would probably pay to watch this shot, that is how good it was. Full and outside off, Rahul leans into it and drives it over covers. The timing is such that the ball goes all the way.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Chris Jordon to bowl from the other end.
Rahul is off the mark with a very good shot! An inswinger on middle, Rahul clips is sweetly through square leg for a run. So a wicket and 8 runs from the first over.
KL Rahul walks out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! What do you want when you are not defending a big total? An early wicket and England have got exactly that. David Willey provides it and it is a big one of the dangerous Dhawan. A full delivery outside off, Dhawan goes for the booming drive with no foot movement. The ball takes the inside edge and shatters the stumps behind. Dhawan walks back dejected and the Englishmen are ecstatic.
Good length on off, Sharma guides it down to third man and gets to the other end. He gets off the mark with that single.
WIDE! Down the leg side and the umpire stretches his hands.
On the pads, Dhawan fails to flick. The ball hits the pads and goes towards short fine leg. The batsmen run a leg bye. The fielder fumbles but no extra run conceded.
Better from Willey bowls this fuller and outside off, Dhawan this time does not throw his bat at it and watchfully keeps it out.

FOUR! Underway with a boundary! Not in convincing manner but Dhawan won't mind. Willey does get some shape away from the batsman but the length is on the shorter side. Dhawan flashes at it but gets an outside edge past the lone slip fielder and into the third man fence.

We are back for the chase. The target is not a big one but India would like a good start from their openers, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan. The latter is on strike and he will be facing David Willey who will be hoping for some movement. Will he get any? We will come to know as he runs up to bowl the first ball.
